reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread under their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. I checked what Pree can see (the #central-team channel and the public Central files on the share) and found nothing on Brackenwater: no contract, CRM note or renewal date to compare it with.

In the reply I said I'm treating 8 April as hearsay. I also said the account owner should check it against the contract or with their contact at Brackenwater before anyone puts it in a tracker or plans around it. I offered to compare it if Pree can point me to the account record.

I haven't recorded the date as fact anywhere. No approval was needed, because a renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure.
